chose: An essay's status comes from Studio's own episode status (lib/episodes-feed's rowsOf and rowStatus, as they stand): ready once Episodes shows its video, on home or out. Until then, home's render board says what its video is doing: couldn't finish (opening Renders), being made while its job is on the line, or waiting while it is queued, waiting for room or set aside, as Renders' conveyor reads a job. Otherwise the essay is written and its video isn't made, with no promise that it will be, since home may have refused it. With no essay listed, the page says only that home lists none (an essay not yet written, one withdrawn, which home keeps but no longer lists, or one for a week another account holds too), and no day is named, since home promises none for an interview essay. While the feed is being read, can't be read until pairing, is one an older home doesn't keep, or got no answer, the page says only that.
options: Studio's episode status, with the board saying what the video is doing
the board alone, as Renders shows it
fixed words for every week not yet ready
gray: What the owner is told about when an essay is coming, and how being made is told apart from waiting.
